items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the southern North Sea, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, gradually settling north or northwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain and drizzle for a time tonight, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in any light rain and drizzle tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 4 or 5, soon decreasing north or northeast 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
